title: Evaluate acoustic prosody with room and microphone controls
summary: Investigate audio-derived pitch/energy/duration patterns while separating the person from room, microphone and recording conditions. Feature computation happens in DIAT on copied audio and never masquerades as a feature that the handoff already computed.
out_of_scope: New production embedding space or resolver calibration
Unbounded GPU/model installation or full-corpus processing without a selected pilot
implementation: Audit copied audio availability, sample-rate/channel/crop metadata and the existing audio-preparation interfaces; select a small reproducible extractor with documented units, licensing and model/version provenance.

Define candidate features only where measurable: voiced pitch contour/range, intensity/energy, durations and local emphasis; store voicing/overlap/noise/clipping coverage and explicit unavailable reasons.
Bind all measurements to original recording spans and input hashes, retaining resampling/channel transforms; never reset a crop's source clock.
Build room/mic/channel regime metadata from known source information or an explicitly experimental classifier; missing regimes remain unknown and shared microphones receive separate controls.
Compare person-heldout, meeting-heldout and channel-regime-shift conditions, including same-person different-mic and different-person same-mic pairs, before admitting features to fusion.

acceptance.criterion: Prosody is computed from actual audio with input/extractor/clock provenance; non-playable or missing audio produces no fabricated feature.
acceptance.verification: Run real small authorized crops and synthetic missing/corrupt controls; inspect feature coverage and failure receipts.

acceptance.criterion: Resampling and crop preparation preserve original recording coordinates.
acceptance.verification: Check a nonzero-offset multi-channel fixture through preparation and feature extraction.

acceptance.criterion: Reported gains survive explicit room/microphone controls or are labeled channel-specific.
acceptance.verification: Compare same-person/different-mic and different-person/same-mic held-out pairs with matched cohort accounting.

acceptance.criterion: No extracted prosody result changes a production vector, enrollment or identity decision.
acceptance.verification: Instrument the experimental path and compare production-state digests before/after the pilot.

tests: Shared podium microphone with alternating people
Stereo channels with one silent channel
Crop resampled from 44.1 kHz with original offset retained
risks: Channel effects can dominate identity-adjacent acoustic measures.
Extractor defaults and speech quality can create biased missing-feature subsets.

reuse.application: Inspect and reuse existing audio preparation and source-span discipline.
Respect feature not_computed/unavailable states in exported packages.

sources: User clarification, 2026-10-08, active Matter build: DIAT owns meeting learning; roughly 315 hours/5–10 recurring people is user-reported; crawler owns jurisdiction knowledge; private exported-data experiments only.
Original repository inputs: matterbrainstormspec; matterjevmesh; jevinmatter (brainstorming, not implementation evidence).
